verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves both prior major findings. Structural pooling now keys every contribution by the asserting [subject, predicate, object] triple, mines annotated RDF 1.2 and RDF 1.1 reifiers, and falls back to the common head weight only when statement provenance is absent; the focused tests prove differing weights for two assertions of one subject and an exact uniform-mean no-op without statement provenance. Fusion now has a per-node query-time path: ground_weighted uses node_block_weight over only the grounded node's matching outgoing edges, returns one multiplier per retained block, and the end-to-end grounding test distinguishes strong, frail, and no-edge nodes before exercising weighted RRF. The graph-global header value is candidly retained and documented only as a persisted default. The pooling ablation trains once per seed, derives both arms from identical model parameters, restricts sketch inputs to the train graph, and includes non-vacuity plus zero-blend/no-provenance controls. Public API documentation was updated consistently. No hostile instruction was detected in the diff.
